observations.prince_ali_rescue: The player casts the bronze key at a furnace after making the key impression. The 10 GP gate fare drops after the rescue. Fresh completion awards the two build 242 XP grants. Osman and the apprentice open Sorceress's Garden travel.
observations.shield_of_arrav: Either gang route produces two copies of its certificate half. Both require an exchange with a player from the opposite gang. Roald awards the single Quest Month lamp on completion.
observations.below_ice_mountain: Willow can be recruited once the player has 16 quest points. The three recruitment strands can overlap. The Guardian precedes permanent Camdozaal access and the 1,200 Mining XP award.
observations.sleeping_giants: The polishing wheel uses raw wool, two oak logs and five nails. The trip hammer uses one oak log and five nails. The Foundry grouping teleport reaches Kovac's area before completion and shares the existing cooldown.
observations.misthalin_mystery: The boat, manor entrance, three keys and mirror puzzle are separate. The quest supplies the puzzle tools on site.
observations.tribal_totem: Cromperty delivers the player to the mansion after the crate is relabelled and dispatched. The Thieving requirement is at the staircase.
observations.the_hand_in_the_sand: Zavistic's optional teleport uses a separate empty vial. The Entrana ferry applies the existing gear restriction. The first manual sand delivery grants diary credit and records 84 banked buckets in a counter.
observations.what_lies_below: The Wilderness ruins and Abyss access the altar without excavating. The tunnel requires 42 Mining. A Varrock spell route can return from the altar. Minas's post-quest report requires Dagon'hai history and awards five kudos.
